title: Circuit Lab: bridge-rectifier ripple vs reservoir capacitance
description: The transformer bench's secondary drives a four-diode bridge into a reservoir capacitor and a 100 Ω load, wired in the Circuit Lab and solved by the C++ MNA solver. Sweep the capacitor over a decade and read the output's peak-to-peak ripple once it has settled: between charging pulses the capacitor alone feeds the load, so the ripple falls as 1/C (textbook ΔV ≈ I/(2fC); the winding's leakage inductance stretches each pulse, so the level sits below it, but the exponent is the claim). The energy books' residual — source energy minus dissipation minus stored change — stays under 1 % on every run. Needs sim_core.wasm (no TS mirror of the solver). Simulated, not metrology.
